package.welcome_message: Welcome to a 3-day adventure through Petra and Wadi Rum, curated with authentic Jordanian experiences and local guides.

trip.title: Petra & Wadi Rum Explorer
trip.summary: Three days of immersive history and photography in Petra and Wadi Rum. Each day is focused on a single region, with morning walks in the heat, shaded afternoons, and local dining that celebrates Jordanian cuisine.

planning.strategy: Each day stays in one area: Petra (2 days), then Wadi Rum. Walk heritage and nature in the morning. Save museums, meals, and shade for the afternoon. About 3 places to visit and 2 meals each day.
assumptions: Travel times between cities are estimated qualitatively, not as exact minutes, unless evidence exists.
Opening hours are used only when present on the catalog record.

climate.typical_pattern: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
climate.outdoor_guidance: Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

days.summary: Morning exploration of Petra's iconic monuments, a quick lunch at a historic tea house, afternoon visit to a lesser-known trail, and dinner at a renowned park restaurant.

schedule.description: An iconic ancient Nabataean rock-cut temple facade carved into the rose-red sandstone cliff face at Petra.
schedule.reason: Must-visit Petra landmark; perfect for photography and historical context.
